prompts.plain:
You are a Class 9 science teacher. Mark this answer out of 10.

Question: Why do we see lightning before we hear thunder? (10 marks)

Student's answer: Lightning and thunder happen at the same time in the cloud. But light travels much faster than sound. Light travels at about 3 lakh km per second, but sound travels at only about 3,000 m/s in air. So the light of the lightning reaches our eyes almost at once, and the sound of the thunder reaches our ears later. For example, if the thunder comes 3 seconds after the lightning, the lightning was about 1 km away.

Reply with just the mark.
